population_note_text: Not walked from the books population: every row is one (section, payee) tax amount already identified as a shortfall by 'TDS on payments made' or 'Partners (s.40(b), s.194T)', with whatever deduction/payment dates the books or documents establish. An unsupplied date is never guessed; it drives a range instead.

figures.definition_text: Reference date for every maximum bound: the return due date from rules[due_dates], or the report date, as supplied by the caller -- this test never reads rules[due_dates] itself.
s.206C(7) rate, per month or part of a month (s.206C(7), status=partial).
s.201(1A) post-deduction rate, per month or part of a month (s.201(1A), status=VP).
s.201(1A) pre-deduction rate, per month or part of a month (s.201(1A), status=VP).
Rows (deducted_date unknown, s.201(1A)) where a payee return-filing date was supplied for the Form 26A relief scenario.
Rows (deducted_date unknown, s.201(1A)) where no payee return-filing date was supplied -- the Form 26A relief scenario could not be computed.
Sum of interest_26a_relief_<row> across only the rows where a payee filing date was supplied -- a partial sum over a subset, never compared directly to total_interest_min/max.
Sum of interest_max_<row> across every default -- the ceiling of the combined range.
Sum of interest_min_<row> across every default -- the floor of the combined range.
Sum of tax_<row> across every default supplied.
